requirement: The Server UUID is a stable lowercase UUID and is rejected when malformed.
Server name, version, vendor URL, and feature identifiers follow the SiLAService constraints, including character length.
SiLAService reports version and implemented features, accepts a valid rename, and rejects malformed or unimplemented feature identifiers.
Validation errors name the fully qualified parameter and travel as a standard-base64 SiLAError on an aborted status.
ASCII and binary gRPC metadata keys prefixed with sila- are rejected because this profile declares no metadata.
Observable executions advertise a lifetime on every info update and cancellation is visible before CancelCommand returns.
All seven LabOperations commands accept valid calls and reject unknown sources, metrics, and runs.
CancelAll is accepted and a malformed execution UUID is a validation error.
Generated certificates carry the SiLA2 names, CA bit, and UTF-8 UUID extension, and fail a UUID mismatch.
DNS-SD goodbye records use TTL 0 and TXT values stay inside one 255-byte character string.
Long Unicode server names are truncated on a character boundary before they enter a TXT record.
ConnectionConfigurationService persists clients and reconnects them after the Feature Provider restarts.

rationale: The advertised LabOperations, SiLAService, CancelController, and ConnectionConfigurationService features declare no Binary parameters.
No advertised feature requires a lock. The profile does not implement the optional Lock Controller.
No advertised feature requires an access token. Those features are exercised only by the separate communication-tester server.

requirement: SiLA Client Metadata affecting feature calls.
rationale: No advertised feature declares metadata. Undeclared sila- metadata is rejected.
